//: SOMET-558. WATCH src/ ONLY, never the whole of backend/.
nodemon's default watch is its working directory, recursively. The dev
compose service bind-mounts ./backend to /app and runs `nodemon
src/index.js` there, so before this file a restart was triggered by any
change under tests/, scripts/, seeds/, migrations/ or the Makefile --
including edits made by a DIFFERENT session sharing this checkout.
That is not cosmetic. An art-generation batch lives only in backend
memory (artDispatcher's module-level `run`), so a restart kills it and
strands every claimed job in state='running'. Measured 2026-09-10: a
batch claimed 10 subjects at 09:25:45Z and a concurrent session writing
tests/helpers/entryWorld.js at 09:29:52Z ended it with 0 done and 0
failed. A 530-image run is hours long; unrelated test edits must not be
able to end it.
Not watching migrations/ is a second fix, not an oversight. MIGRATE_ON_BOOT
is true for this service, so a restart runs migrations -- and a restart
triggered by the migration file being SAVED runs it half-written, straight
off the bind mount. That has already happened here once.
The cost is that a change outside src/ needs a manual restart. That is the
right trade: everything outside src/ is run deliberately (npm test, a
migrate command), never by the server picking it up.
